requirements.description: 根目录改名为 ShipKeel（根 package.json 设为 name: shipkeel, private: true, workspaces: [scaffolds/*]），并重写根 README.md 与 AGENTS.md（根目录只保留 C1–C11 通用契约与 ShipProof 协议块）。

将现有运行时（src/、test/、scripts/、knowledge/、tsconfig.json、entrypoint.sh、.env.example 与运行时文档）完整迁入 scaffolds/plan-execute/，作为 @shipkeel/plan-execute 子包（保留 bin: dah、yaml 唯一运行时依赖与 build/qa/gop 三域全部示例资产），并建立 scaffolds/plan-execute/AGENTS.md 承接局部约束。
在根目录建立纯 Markdown 的 playbook/：包含 L0–L4 五级范式决策树、可叠加模式积木、各范式内框架选型指南，以及 4 份引用真实代码证据的案例拆解（playbook/cases/visual-studio.md、atoms.md、campaign-build.md、finance.md）。
在根目录建立 contracts/：完整定义 C1–C11 通用契约的规则说明、反例与确定性检查方法。
更新 .github/workflows/ci.yml、.gitignore、harness.config.json、.harness/verify.json 与 .harness/standards.md，使根目录 workspace 命令、CI 资产校验、安全扫描与 fh verify / fh gate 在新目录结构下 100% 全绿。
全仓无断链、无旧根路径残留、无密钥或内网标识泄露，scaffolds/plan-execute 原有 typecheck / test / build / smoke / list-domains 全部离线通过。

items.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('scaffolds/plan-execute/package.json','utf8')); if(p.name!=='@shipkeel/plan-execute'||p.bin?.dah!=='dist/index.js') process.exit(1); for(const f of ['scaffolds/plan-execute/AGENTS.md','scaffolds/plan-execute/README.md','scaffolds/plan-execute/tsconfig.json','scaffolds/plan-execute/src/index.ts','scaffolds/plan-execute/knowledge/README.md']) if(!fs.existsSync(f)) process.exit(1);"
items.description: scaffolds/plan-execute is a valid @shipkeel/plan-execute workspace with bin dah, AGENTS.md, runtime, and sample assets

items.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of ['playbook/README.md','playbook/patterns.md','playbook/frameworks.md','playbook/cases/visual-studio.md','playbook/cases/atoms.md','playbook/cases/campaign-build.md','playbook/cases/finance.md']) { if(!fs.existsSync(f)||fs.statSync(f).size<400) process.exit(1); } const readme=fs.readFileSync('playbook/README.md','utf8'); for(const l of ['L0','L1','L2','L3','L4']) if(!readme.includes(l)) process.exit(1);"

items.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path"); const fence=new RegExp(String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3)+String.raw`[\s\S]*?`+String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3),"g"); const files=[]; function walk(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(["node_modules",".git","dist",".harness",".agents"].includes(e.name)) continue; const f=p.join(d,e.name); if(e.isDirectory()) walk(f); else if(e.name.endsWith(".md")) files.push(f);}} walk("."); const broken=[]; for(const f of files){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").replace(fence,""); for(const m of s.matchAll(/\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)/g)){const raw=m[1].split("#")[0].trim(); if(!raw||/^(https?:|mailto:|file:)/.test(raw)) continue; const target=p.resolve(p.dirname(f),raw); if(!fs.existsSync(target)) broken.push(f+" -> "+m[1]);}} if(broken.length){console.error(broken.join("\n")); process.exit(1);}'
items.description: RL-3: Zero broken relative Markdown links across all repository documentation
